aboutGame.title: What is Carduels?
paragraphs: Carduels (Car DUELS) is an intense vehicular sumo combat game on Roblox developed by %100 CARS. Players join either the Red or Blue faction and battle on elevated platforms with no guardrails, colliding head-to-head to knock opponents off the arena edge while maintaining their own footing.

Victory requires balancing raw momentum, vehicular weight classes, and tactical positioning. Earn Cash from triumphant duels to purchase new cars, reinforce front bumpers, and upgrade handling to outmaneuver rivals in high-stakes physics-driven showdowns.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Carduels.

items.question: What is Carduels on Roblox?
items.answer: Carduels is a free-to-play Roblox vehicle sumo game by %100 CARS where Red and Blue teams ram each other off elevated platforms using upgraded garage cars.

items.question: How do I earn Cash fast in Carduels?
items.answer: In Carduels, you earn Cash by winning arena duels, scoring ring-out knockbacks, completing daily quests, and redeeming active promo codes.

items.question: What are the best upgrades to buy in Carduels?
items.answer: The best garage investments in Carduels are reinforced front bumpers and chassis weight upgrades, which maximize collision force and survival.

items.question: Where can I find active codes for Carduels?
items.answer: Active Carduels codes are updated on our dedicated codes page and released by %100 CARS during community milestone events.

items.question: What platforms and controls does Carduels support?
items.answer: Carduels supports PC, mobile, and console devices with intuitive driving controls, drift mechanics, and boost features across all platforms.
